outline.en: The teacher asked us to outline our ideas before writing the essay.
outline.zh: 老師要我們在寫作文前先列出想法大綱。

outlook.en: Her positive outlook helped the team stay calm during setbacks.
outlook.zh: 她積極的看法幫助團隊在遇到挫折時保持冷靜。

outnumber.en: In the club, first-year students outnumber seniors by nearly two to one.
outnumber.zh: 社團裡一年級學生的人數幾乎是高年級學生的兩倍。

output.en: The factory increased its output after installing more efficient equipment.
output.zh: 工廠安裝更有效率的設備後提高了產量。

outrage.en: The unfair decision caused public outrage across the community.
outrage.zh: 那項不公平的決定在社區引起公憤。

outrageous.en: The article criticized the outrageous price increase at the event.
outrageous.zh: 這篇文章批評活動中離譜的漲價。

outright.en: The committee rejected the proposal outright after reviewing the evidence.
outright.zh: 委員會審查證據後直接否決了這項提案。

outset.en: At the outset, everyone agreed on the main goals of the project.
outset.zh: 一開始，大家就同意這項專題的主要目標。

outsider.en: As an outsider, he noticed details that longtime residents often missed.
outsider.zh: 身為外來者，他注意到長期居民常忽略的細節。

outskirts.en: The new sports center stands on the outskirts of the city.
outskirts.zh: 新的運動中心位於城市郊區。

outstanding.en: Her outstanding presentation earned praise from both teachers and students.
outstanding.zh: 她出色的報告獲得老師與學生的稱讚。

outward.en: The door opens outward toward the school courtyard.
outward.zh: 這扇門向外打開，通往學校中庭。

outwards.en: The branches spread outwards as the young tree grew.
outwards.zh: 幼樹長大時，樹枝向外伸展。

oval.en: The designer chose an oval table for the small meeting room.
oval.zh: 設計師為小會議室選了一張橢圓形桌子。

oven.en: The bread was already in the oven when we arrived.
oven.zh: 我們到達時，麵包已經放進烤箱裡。

overcoat.en: He wore a thick overcoat during the cold winter morning.
overcoat.zh: 寒冷的冬日早晨，他穿著一件厚大衣。

overcome.en: Regular practice helped her overcome her fear of speaking in class.
overcome.zh: 規律練習幫助她克服在課堂上發言的恐懼。

overdo.en: Do not overdo the decorations, or the poster may look crowded.
overdo.zh: 不要把裝飾做得太過頭，否則海報可能看起來很擁擠。

overflow.en: Heavy rain caused the small river to overflow its banks.

overhead.en: An overhead light made the reading table bright enough for study.
overhead.zh: 頭頂的燈光讓閱讀桌亮得足以讀書。

overhear.en: I happened to overhear part of the conversation in the hallway.
overhear.zh: 我碰巧在走廊聽到那段對話的一部分。

overlook.en: Do not overlook the final question at the bottom of the page.
overlook.zh: 不要漏看頁面底部的最後一題。

overnight.en: The temperature dropped sharply overnight after the cold front arrived.
overnight.zh: 冷鋒到達後，氣溫一夜之間大幅下降。

overseas.en: She hopes to study overseas after finishing high school.
overseas.zh: 她希望高中畢業後到海外留學。

oversee.en: A teacher will oversee the students during the science fair.
oversee.zh: 科展期間會有老師負責監督學生。

overtake.en: The faster train began to overtake the local service outside town.
overtake.zh: 較快的列車在城外開始超越區間車。

overthrow.en: The history chapter explains why citizens sought to overthrow the old regime.
overthrow.zh: 歷史章節解釋人民為何想推翻舊政權。

overturn.en: New evidence may overturn the earlier conclusion in the report.
overturn.zh: 新證據可能推翻報告中先前的結論。

overwhelm.en: Too many notifications can overwhelm students during focused study time.
overwhelm.zh: 太多通知可能在專心讀書時讓學生不堪負荷。

overwork.en: Constant pressure can lead people to overwork and lose concentration.
overwork.zh: 持續的壓力可能讓人工作過度並失去專注力。

owl.en: An owl rested quietly on a branch near the forest trail.
owl.zh: 一隻貓頭鷹安靜停在森林步道附近的樹枝上。

ownership.en: The project gave students a sense of ownership over their learning.
ownership.zh: 這項專題讓學生對自己的學習更有主人翁意識。

ox.en: An ox pulled the cart slowly across the muddy field.
ox.zh: 一頭牛慢慢拉著車穿過泥濘田地。

oxygen.en: Plants release oxygen as part of the process of photosynthesis.
oxygen.zh: 植物在光合作用過程中會釋放氧氣。

oyster.en: The biology display included a shell from a large oyster.
oyster.zh: 生物展示中有一枚大型牡蠣的殼。

ozone.en: The lesson explained how ozone helps protect Earth from harmful radiation.
ozone.zh: 課堂說明臭氧如何幫助地球抵擋有害輻射。

pace.en: She maintained a steady pace throughout the long walk.
pace.zh: 她在整段長途步行中保持穩定步調。

pack.en: Please pack your notebook and water bottle before the field trip.
pack.zh: 校外教學前請把筆記本和水壺裝好。

package.en: The package arrived at the school office before noon.
package.zh: 包裹在中午前送到學校辦公室。

packet.en: The teacher handed each group a packet of reading materials.
packet.zh: 老師發給每組一包閱讀資料。

pad.en: He wrote the phone number on a small note pad.
pad.zh: 他把電話號碼寫在一本小便條本上。

paddle.en: They used a paddle to move the canoe across the calm lake.
paddle.zh: 他們用槳讓獨木舟穿過平靜的湖面。

painful.en: The loss was painful, but the team learned from the experience.
painful.zh: 那次失敗令人難受，但團隊從中學到經驗。

painter.en: The local painter displayed landscapes inspired by nearby mountains.
painter.zh: 那位在地畫家展出受附近山景啟發的風景畫。

pajamas.en: He changed into comfortable pajamas before reading in bed.
pajamas.zh: 他睡前閱讀前換上舒適的睡衣。

pal.en: My old pal from elementary school visited me last weekend.
pal.zh: 我小學時的老朋友上週末來看我。

palace.en: The tourists admired the palace from across the wide square.
palace.zh: 遊客從寬廣廣場另一側欣賞那座宮殿。

pale.en: The morning sky turned pale as the sun rose behind clouds.
pale.zh: 太陽從雲後升起時，晨空變得淡淡的。

palm.en: She held the small stone in the center of her palm.
palm.zh: 她把小石頭放在手掌中央。

pan.en: The cook placed the vegetables in a large pan.
pan.zh: 廚師把蔬菜放進一個大平底鍋裡。
